paper.title: Using distances between Top-n-gram and residue pairs for protein remote homology detection
paper.citation: Liu B, Xu J, Zou Q, Xu R, Wang X, Chen Q. BMC Bioinformatics 15(Suppl 2):S3 (2014)

items.label: Gist 2.3 port against Gist's own sample run

check.detail: Gist's printed weights through our kernel give its printed training discriminants within 0.003 (weight rounding). Retrained with the sample's settings and seed: objective 0.0173670 against Gist's 0.0173686, 1591 of 1644 weights equal as printed, 196 passes against 200. The sample came from Gist 2.0.

cause.summary: A worked example of the feature vector (AGLP to KFFK, dMAX = 2); nothing to recompute.
Pseudocode of the Distance-based Top-1-gram vector; it is the method, implemented in features.py.

controls.name: SVM-DT values in place of SVM-DR

assumptions.sensitivity: The markers sit within 0.1 of these values on the fitted x axis; the paper names only 150

assumptions.what: Normalized kernel values that round above 1 (identical sequences) are capped at 1, where Gist's code sets them to 0 off the diagonal
assumptions.sensitivity: With Gist's 0 the dMAX = 0 training diverges to NaN (Gist would loop forever); at dMAX = 150 the SVM-DR weights of family 2.5.1.3 become 1.3 times the published ones (Fig. 4B Spearman 0.954 against 0.9999, Fig. 5C r 0.85 against 0.9999; output/causes/weight_scale_dr.json)

assumptions.what: Gist seeds its random update order from the clock; we use seed 1
assumptions.sensitivity: Seeds 2 and 3 move the 2.5.1.3 weights' L2 maximum by under 0.5% (output/causes/weight_scale_dr.json)

cause.summary: Nine of ten points come back within 0.0005 ROC; dMAX 20 is 0.0013 above the published point (0.9004 against 0.8991, about 10 px).

cause.summary: The gains are measured against SVM-Top-n-gram's values quoted from another paper. Our ROC gain is 4.3 points (paper 4.1); our ROC50 is lower across the board, so against the quoted 0.696 it shows a loss. Against our own position-independent baseline (SVM-DT at dMAX 0, Top-1-gram composition) the gains are 4.0 ROC and 25.7 ROC50 points, so the direction of the claim holds.
